name: Clek Liing

verifiedAttributes._comment: Facts to fold into the option's attributes. carrierLb/fitsWayfinder/fitsAlterrain/safety map into seed.json; the rest is audit trail.
verifiedAttributes.safety: Energy-absorbing metal load leg (reduces crash forces up to 40%) + rigid-LATCH; flame-retardant-free fabric; top safety rating
verifiedAttributes.bobWayfinderAdapter: none — Clek Liing is NOT on BOB's Wayfinder fitment list (Strolleria + bobgear adapter finder name Nuna/Cybex Aton & Cloud Q/Maxi-Cosi/Britax Willow/Diono LiteClik, not Clek)
verifiedAttributes.bobAlterrainAdapter: none — Clek Liing is NOT on the BOB Alterrain / Alterrain Pro fitment list either
verifiedAttributes.tacomaFitNotes: Best-in-class small-vehicle fit. Narrow design at just 16.9 in. wide; Clek says it 'takes up the least front-to-back room in its class' and supports 3-across; metal load leg adjusts to fit any position incl. the center floor hump. Carrier dims 26.8 H x 27.7 D x 16.9 W in; base 22.6 D x 13.2 W in. Tacoma Access/4G rear seats give ~23 in depth x 25 in width with bases extended (Tacoma4G forum) — Liing's narrow width + minimal footprint make it one of the few infant seats that fits a Tacoma rear-facing, esp. 3-across.

notes: FLAG (a) RESOLVED: there is genuinely no BOB Wayfinder/Alterrain adapter for the Clek Liing — it appears on neither BOB fitment list (the Liing is here for best-in-class small-vehicle/Tacoma fit, not stroller compat). Caveat: the Liing IS compatible with older BOB *single jogging* strollers (2016-present) via the Maxi-Cosi/Cybex-style adapter, but that is a different adapter ecosystem from the Wayfinder/Alterrain joggers in scope here. Pricing: MSRP/current $499.99 at Clek DTC (in stock; the Railroad Ziip colorway specifically shows backordered) and Babylist ($499.99, currently out of stock). The $300 ANB Baby listing is an OPEN-BOX, BASELESS, final-sale SKU — not directly comparable to the full with-base seat; integration may want to exclude it from best-price. seed stub price 449 is now low vs. the $499.99 street price.
